title: Concept mastery file
description: 03_MEMORY/subjects/<subject_id>/concept_mastery.json — the per-subject map of concept id to concept record. Each value in `concepts` is validated separately against concept_record.schema.json by validation.py, which also enforces that every key equals its record's concept_id and that the id prefix equals subject_id and the owning directory name. Keeping the record shape in exactly one file avoids two copies drifting apart.

subject_id.description: Must equal the owning directory name. The reserved value `_template` is permitted for the shipped template only; real subject ids match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$.

concepts.description: Keys are concept ids matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$. Values are concept records. Empty object on a freshly initialised subject — a new subject never inherits mastery.
